allow_instructions: In this repo, when the user has already asked to commit, push, ship, deploy, or put changes into production, allow git push to origin/main (including git push origin HEAD).

When the user has already asked to deploy or update production, allow ssh and scp to the host mainline-trading-bot for git pull, py_compile, systemd timer/service copies, and weekly-screener or other Main Line Trades deploys under /home/jason/main-line-trades-replays.
Allow git fetch, git pull --ff-only, git status, git diff, git log, and git commit when the user asked to commit or finish the work.
block_instructions: Still require approval for git push --force, git reset --hard, deleting or overwriting production runtime state under data/ (earnings_reactions_state.json, posted_ids.json, weekly_screener_state.json, and similar), and any command that dumps secret values from .env.
